newsitem.title: USA: JJFN Services buys 70 acres in Florida.
newsitem.headline: JJFN Services buys 70 acres in Florida.

text.p: JJFN Services Inc said Tuesday it has bought 70 acres in western Boca Raton for a residential housing community and agreed to develop the property with a subsidiary of Engle Homes Inc.
The value of the developed property will be more than $13 milion, the company said, nearly doubling JJFN's asset base.

Boca Raton-based JJFN Services Inc buys and leases back model homes, land, accounts receivable financing and factoring for businesses. Its subsidiary, Iron Eagle Contracting Corp of Queens, New York, is involved in developing residential real estate and construction in New York boroughs.
